sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Turns off analytics and tracking (Firebase, Mixpanel, comScore, MediaLab Analytics, and Facebook).
Makes Spotify login work in the patched app by signing in on Spotify's web page instead of the Spotify app.
Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes the sticky banner, inline feed and search ads, video pre-roll ads, and disables ad SDKs.
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
